hotspot_choice.prompt: Identify the visual component highlighted in hotspot HS_01.

questions.hint_modal: Recall the primary definition or historical event in Chapter 7.
questions.correct_answer: Push factors are distress conditions in rural areas that compel people to leave (agricultural stagnation, drought, lack of local jobs). questions.question: Evaluate how citizen-led trust initiatives in Bengaluru successfully addressed urban lake pollution and water depletion.

hotspot_choice.prompt: Identify the visual component highlighted in hotspot HS_01.

questions.hint_modal: Recall the primary definition or historical event in Chapter 7.
questions.correct_answer: Faced with rapid urban expansion and polluted wetlands, Bengaluru citizen groups formed neighborhood trusts. They partnered with municipal bodies to stop raw sewage inflows, desilt lake beds, construct diversion channels, and plant green buffer belts along lake banks, successfully recharging local groundwater aquifers.
